tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Page ground. The default background everywhere: warm paper by day, a candlelit room by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on linen: cards, sheets, the vault preview, modals, form fields. In Candlelight it is a step lighter than linen, because shadows barely show on dark screens; pair cards with a 1px line border there.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Tinted bands and highlights: a featured section, a selected entry, the background of a personal message. Use for at most one band per screen.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders at 1px. In Candlelight every card gets a line border, since shadows don't read on dark screens. Never the only border on an input; inputs use ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on linen, paper and blush. Also headings and the wordmark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, input borders and placeholder text on linen and paper (5.9:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: heartwood
tokens.usage: The brand colour: a warm clay-rose, the colour of the inside of a tree. Primary buttons, links, the one thing on a screen we want tapped. Text-safe on linen in both themes (5.1:1 light, 6.6:1 dark). On blush, heartwood text is only for 24px+ type (4.35:1 in Daylight); use heartwood-deep for smaller text there.

tokens.name: heartwood-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of heartwood surfaces and links.

tokens.name: on-heartwood
tokens.usage: Text and icons on heartwood fills (5.6:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: keepsake
tokens.usage: Deep plum for weight and intimacy: the footer, the sealed-vault moment, large decorative blocks. On light it carries linen text; on dark it is a light block carrying linen-dark text.

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: Warm gold: the ribbon on the gift. Decorative only (fills, illustrations, a single highlight underline). Never text on linen. Text on a lantern fill uses on-lantern.

tokens.name: on-lantern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lantern fills (7.7:1 Daylight, dark ink in Candlelight because lantern stays bright).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Growth and done: 'added to your vault', completed executor tasks, the growing-rings motif. Text-safe on linen (5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with an icon and words, never colour alone. Kept a wine-crimson so it reads apart from heartwood.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: partner-accent
tokens.usage: Partner mode only. Defaults to heartwood; an employer, insurer or bank may override it with their brand colour for primary actions, if it passes 4.5:1 on linen in both themes. Never used for the ground, type or still-mode screens.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: A gift that grows with your life.
styles.usage: Section openers on the landing page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: For the people you love most.

styles.name: display-xl-mobile
styles.usage: Hero headline on screens under 640px wide.

styles.name: display-l-mobile
styles.sample: A gift that grows with your life.

styles.name: display-m-mobile
styles.sample: For the people you love most.
styles.usage: Section titles and screen titles in the app.

styles.name: display-s-mobile
styles.usage: Card titles and pull quotes on mobile.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: When the time comes, they won't be guessing.

styles.name: body-l-mobile
styles.sample: When the time comes, they won't be guessing.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs on mobile. Body text never goes below 16px on mobile; inputs stay at 16px so iOS doesn't zoom.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add the accounts your family would need to find.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase kicker above a section title. Uppercase is applied in CSS; write it in sentence case.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Handwritten voice, used ONLY for the user's own words: message titles, a quoted line from a letter. Never for UI, never for marketing claims.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips and inputs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between label and field; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card inner gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Mobile page margin (left and right) and gap between stacked cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; the pause before an emotional moment.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons that are not pills, list rows, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the vault preview: soft, like a keepsake box.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and avatar stacks.

shadow.note: Shadows are warm (tinted with keepsake plum), soft and low. Nothing floats far; things rest.

tokens.name: rest
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, the opened vault, modals.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: A lantern halo around something newly added or just unlocked. Used once, briefly.
